text:
aj_support: P1 -> Luminacare onboarding: embeddings provisioning failing for multiple workspaces, customer sees 502 / upstream timeouts when calling /v1/embeddings. Support couldn't reproduce internally; customer consistently hits it. Escalating to CS for immediate comms and to flag renewal risk (renewal 2026-10-15). Incident #6789 opened. @evan_csm @sree_manager please advise. logs below:
```
2026-03-20T11:02:33Z ERROR embedding: requestid=abc123 downstream=502 body="upstream timeout"
2026-03-20T11:05:10Z ERROR embedding: requestid=def456 downstream=504 body="gateway timeout"
```

evan_csm: Thanks AJ. I'm on it. Can you confirm affected workspaces and whether any are on Dedicated/Private? I need the list + contact personas. Also pause any automated renewal nudges for this account.

aj_support: Affected: luminacare-prod, luminacare-staging. Both are Hosted. Primary contacts: kate@luminacare.com (Head of ML), ops@luminacare.com (SRE). Confirming pause on nudges. Full request ids: abc123, def456.

maria_cs: @evan_csm I'll draft a short customer comms now. Proposed language (keep it short + empathetic): "We're investigating a provisioning issue affecting embeddings in your workspace. Our engineers are actively working on a fix and we'll update you within 2 hours with a mitigation plan. Apologies for the disruption — we're prioritizing this." Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

jordan_se: Quick mitigation to offer customer: try model=redwood-small as a temporary variant or increase client timeout to 60s. Also ask them to check prefix cache; sometimes stale cache + concurrency triggers upstream timeouts. If they can, run:
```
POST /v1/admin/cache/flush
{ "workspace": "luminacare-prod" }
```
That often unblocks provisioning while we root cause.

sree_manager: @evan_csm @maria_cs tag for renewal-risk: set renewal_risk=high in Gainsight and notify renewals@redwood. Schedule a call with Kate within 4 hours and include sales/renewals on the invite. Owners: 
- aj_support: continue logging + escalate to eng-runtime
- jordan_se: own mitigation instructions and confirm patch path
- evan_csm: customer comms, call, and capture decision tree
- maria_cs: draft postmortem template and capture feedback for onboarding playbook

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-20T11:10 UTC -> eng-runtime patch candidate 0.4.3 pushed by @jordan_se

evan_csm: Call scheduled 11:30 UTC, I'll send comms + workaround. Adding @renewals to loop.

maria_cs: Draft comms sent to Kate and ops; included the mitigation steps and ETA for next update. I'll log customer tone and any asks into the onboarding feedback doc.

aj_support: Updating incident #6789 with customer replies and attaching traces. Priority remains P1. Will escalate if we see error rate increase.

evan_csm: Quick summary for execs if needed: Luminacare hosted embeddings provisioning failing -> P1, workaround available (redwood-small / cache flush), patch candidate deployed to eng-runtime (0.4.3). If fix not in prod within 3 hours, escalate to exec. :exclamation:
